mechanicalVerdict.evidence: Card, quick layer, and deep layer meet the locked visible-character bounds; metadata, two-layer structure, four observable-detail bullets, a work-specific final look, fact boundary, clickable sources, and the complete hash chain are present.

evidence: The closing claim ‘一群人共同维持、观看却无人跨过的距离’ upgrades visible positions and distance into an unsupported causal/ethical claim that the bystanders collectively maintain the condition. The supplied evidence supports where they stand and that they watch, but not their agency in maintaining the institution or situation.
The body otherwise respects the stated unknowns about crime, political identity, outcome, psychology, light source, and the exact relationship between the two paintings.

The deep historical-context paragraph can move before the opening spatial-analysis paragraph without losing a premise, and the painting-technique paragraph depends on the opening spatial analysis rather than on the intervening history paragraph. The history and technique paragraphs are therefore substantially exchangeable, triggering the locked paragraph-dependency failure.

Card/quick independence fails: the card’s ‘真正让场面绷紧的却是他们之间无人踏入的空地’ and the quick layer’s ‘他与众人之间那块空地，反而成了画面最紧张的部分’ use the same contrast, image, and conclusion in near-paraphrase form rather than functioning as independently written layers.
Quick/deep progression is otherwise intelligible: the quick layer supplies a provisional answer and the deep layer adds spatial mechanism, context, technique, comparison, and collection boundary.

nativeChineseVerdict.oneBreathParaphrase: 这幅画最紧张的地方不是人物表情，而是囚犯与围观者之间没人跨过的空地；画家用站位、明暗和室内空间把刑罚中的群体关系画了出来。
nativeChineseVerdict.evidence: The title, quick layer, transitions, and final look can be read aloud and naturally restated in Chinese; no English-style compressed title or decoding-heavy metaphor blocks comprehension.

significanceVerdict.label: 重要藏品

fiveDimensions.artisticAchievement: PASS — the prose identifies spatial separation, figure placement, dark tonal field, and white accents as the concrete formal mechanism.
fiveDimensions.artHistoricalPosition: PASS — it places the work in Munkácsy’s early social-realist condemned-prisoner theme without claiming invention, peak, or primacy.
fiveDimensions.historicalCulturalValue: PASS — it connects punishment, confinement, group viewing, and post-1848–49 Hungarian social context while refusing to turn the image into a record of a specific case.
fiveDimensions.rarityAndIrreplaceability: PASS — rarity and exact version status remain unknown, so the prose does not claim global uniqueness or rare-treasure status.
fiveDimensions.collectionPosition: PASS — it gives the work a bounded role as an uncommon social-realist node in the Frye Founding Collection.

significanceVerdict.nearestComparator: Mihály de Munkácsy, The Last Day of a Condemned Man, 1870
significanceVerdict.sharedCore: A confined person, an interior, and onlookers jointly organize the narrative.
significanceVerdict.nonSubstitutabilityBoundary: The comparator can supply the same broad thematic core, while the Frye work offers a tighter spatial arrangement and a specific role inside the Founding Collection. Because the exact version relationship and global rarity are unresolved, this supports ‘重要藏品’ but not ‘稀世珍品’ or a trip-determining claim.

workSpecificVerdict.evidence: The core question, ankle restraint, wall-bound group, empty floor, white bedding/clothing, right-side bright area, and final eye movement are specific enough that the text cannot be transferred unchanged to another work.

productionLanguageVerdict.evidence: No visitor-facing research-gap, image-license task, publication task/status, test, prompt, generator, reviewer, version-migration, or pre-publication production language appears.

independenceChecks.cardVsQuick: FAIL — near-paraphrase of the same empty-space contrast and tension claim.
independenceChecks.quickVsDeep: PASS — some necessary thesis recurrence is followed by additional mechanism, history, technique, comparison, and boundary.
independenceChecks.cardVsDeep: PASS — the deep layer materially develops the card’s observation rather than merely expanding its wording.

入口.evidence: ‘题名把注意力推向死囚，画家却让一群旁观者沿墙围住暗室’ immediately creates a concrete title/composition problem.

因果.evidence: The account links empty floor, positions, tonal divisions, and the related 1870 work to why the scene’s social tension is legible.

人.evidence: The prisoner and onlookers make the institutional theme understandable through their visible relationship, but no sourced human choice or motive can carry the history further.

转折.evidence: Understanding shifts from the titled individual to the spatial relation between restrained person and watching group, then is bounded by the comparator and unresolved version status.

视觉兑现.evidence: ‘脚踝附近可见束缚’, the empty floor, wall-bound figures, white fabric, and right-side bright area repeatedly return the argument to observable evidence.

口语清晰度.evidence: The quick layer and main transitions read naturally aloud and preserve the necessary historical and evidentiary limits.

第二眼.evidence: The ending gives a precise eye movement from ankle restraint to the wall group and then to the empty floor, using the acquired spatial reading.

actionableFailureReasons: Remove or evidence/narrow the unsupported implication in ‘一群人共同维持’ so that the ending remains within observable group position and viewing rather than assigning collective causal or ethical agency.

Rebuild the deep paragraph dependency so the historical-context, painting-technique, and comparison/significance paragraphs each require the understanding established immediately before them; the present history and technique paragraphs remain reorderable.
Make the card and quick layer independently functional instead of restating the same ‘onlookers around one man / unentered empty space creates tension’ contrast in near-paraphrase.
finalRationale: Mechanical checks and the 13/14 voice threshold pass, but the unsupported causal/ethical upgrade, paragraph-dependency hard-gate failure, and card/quick independence failure require an overall FAIL.
